subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three stale pin guards are repaired and exact-head checks pass, does the security owner approve these executable GitHub Action revisions for the token, CodeQL, publishing, release, and Codex workflows?
rationale: The patch is mechanically repairable, but it changes third-party executable code across secret-bearing and security-sensitive workflows and carries the protected security label, so final acceptance requires repository security-owner intent.

options.title: Approve after guard repair
options.body: Require the three pin-test updates and green exact-head workflow validation, then approve the reviewed immutable action revisions.

options.title: Split sensitive upgrades
options.body: Separate token, Codex, CodeQL, and publishing action changes into smaller owner-reviewed pull requests if the grouped security review is too broad.

recommendation.title: Approve after guard repair
recommendation.body: Require the three pin-test updates and green exact-head workflow validation, then approve the reviewed immutable action revisions.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the central dependency-guard surface to this team and the protected security label requires its explicit handling.
